concepts.name: Inversion Fair Value Gap Entry and Scale-In
rules: Identify an Inversion Fair Value Gap (IFVG) acting as support in an anticipated bullish run.
Enter initial position inside or at the low/high threshold of the IFVG.
Add additional contracts (scale-in) when price retests the top or deep end of the IFVG and respects it.
Trail stop loss to the low of the IFVG minus 1-2 ticks once the retest is qualified.
entryCriteria: Price enters or retests an Inversion Fair Value Gap
Candle bodies respect the IFVG level and fail to close below key low threshold
Anticipation of target draw on liquidity toward midnight open price
concepts.invalidation: Candle bodies close below the lower boundary of the Inversion Fair Value Gap or breach the defined key defensive low.
quotes: I'm inside this here. I'm trying to view this as an inversion fair value gap.
My average across all those orders is essentially the high of the inversion fair value gap there.

concepts.name: Wick Consequent Encroachment & Candle Body Defense
rules: Mark the 50% midpoint (Consequent Encroachment / CE) of prominent wicks in the direction of the trade.
Candle wicks are allowed to pierce below/above CE, but candle bodies must NOT close past the CE level.
A close above the candle open price or above the CE of a key wick confirms immediate willingness to continue higher.
If a candle closes below CE of a key defensive wick, expect deeper retracements or high-resistance conditions.
entryCriteria: Use as structural confirmation during order management and position maintenance
concepts.invalidation: Candle bodies bury/close beyond the Consequent Encroachment of the defensive wick.
quotes: I don't want to see any bodies buried south of its consequent encroachment level.
If you understand the language, you'll be able to sit in front of the candlesticks like this and watch them live.

concepts.name: Defensive Retracement Partialing & Stop-Loss Scaling
rules: In high-resistance or disorganized market run conditions, take initial partial profits at immediate targets like NY Midnight Open.
If price hesitates and threatens to retrace below a minor short-term low, place a defensive stop order for a partial position above full stop loss.
Executing a partial stop-out on a pullback reduces net position exposure, locks in gains, and removes psychological strain.
Allow the remaining partial contracts to ride with stop anchored under validated structural lows.
entryCriteria: Price reaches first key draw (e.g., Midnight Open) and faces heavy resistance
Candle momentum slows near major structural resistance
concepts.invalidation: Position stopped out fully at the anchored low.
quotes: I put two contracts on a stop right here... if it goes below there, it's going to sell two of the seven I had as a partial.
It completely subdues the aching of 'please go to my target'... You're managing the position.

summary.summary: This video demonstrates live intraday trade execution and management using Inversion Fair Value Gaps and candle body behavior relative to wick Consequent Encroachment (CE). ICT emphasizes anticipating price behavior on the hard right edge, targeting the NY Midnight Opening Price, and applying defensive partial stops during high-resistance conditions to manage risk and psychology.
